messages:
ela_sales: Quick sync  EuroBank wants a 2-week POC: hard EU-only residency (no US subprocessors), BYO-KMS, tenant pinning, and explicit routing policy we can sign off. Sales needs region list, subprocessor attestation timeline, routing policy snippet, and POC uplift by EOD Thu.

zack_sre: We can pin to eu-west-1, eu-central-1, eu-west-3. Storage options in-EU (AWS/GCS). Monitoring runs on Datadog EU tenancy but vendor support access may be cross-border  will request attestation. Will produce a tiny perf appendix (p99/p50 latency) per region.

mira_se: BYO-KMS supported for Dedicated and Private. Flow: customer provides KMS ARN + cross-account role; we envelope-encrypt and never import raw keys. Note: compliance review ~7 business days for BYO-KMS. Drafting runbook and sample IAM trust now.

jon_presales: Pricing: geo-pin POC uplift +13% on POC commit; strict EU-only (no global fallback) +22% due to reserved capacity. We can offer conditional waiver for geo-pin if they commit to Dedicated within 60 days (requires RevOps approval). Preparing two quote variants.

attest_bot: ATT-559 created: Requested Datadog EU support access attestation and subprocessor addendum. ETA ~4 business days. Link: https://intra.redwood/attest/ATT-559

legal_qa: If they require "no non-EU human access" to telemetry, legal addendum and technical plan required; recommend Private deployment or VPC telemetry proxy. Escalate if customer won't accept vendor access under NDA.

ela_sales: Action items: 1) @zack_sre finalize region/perf matrix, 2) @mira_se publish BYO-KMS runbook + curl/IAM snippet, 3) @jon_presales share two quotes and waiver language, 4) @legal_qa & @attest_bot get Datadog attestation & addendum. Need everything by EOD Thu so we can share with EuroBank. :thumbsup:
